title: The 60-Second Budget Trick
script:
Stop struggling with complicated spreadsheets and tracking every single penny because it is a total waste of your time.

Instead, use the sixty-second budget trick by dividing your paycheck into three simple automated buckets the moment it arrives.

Send fifty percent to your needs, thirty percent to your wants, and twenty percent straight to your future wealth.

Set it up once, let your bank do the heavy lifting, and hit subscribe to PocketIQ for more fast money tips!
